rag.text:
Test: TC-538 — Global - Workload plans - Resynchronize with Tempo
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-39 Global - Workload plans
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Workload
   Data: _Tempo_ should be installed
   Expected: Workload tab is displayed
2. Add new Workload scheme passing this set of data
   Data: name: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit
description: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit
Mon: 4h
Tue: 8h
Wed: 8h
Thu: 8h
Fri: 4h
Sat: 0h
Sun: 0h
   Expected: Workload scheme is added
3. Add new Workload scheme passing this set of data
   Data: name: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit 2 
description: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit 2
Mon: 4h
Tue: 8h
Wed: 8h
Thu: 8h
Fri: 4h
Sat: 0h
Sun: 0h
   Expected: Workload scheme is added
4. Navigate to BP Administration -> Workload plans tab and click Synchronize with Tempo button
   Expected: "TC-538 Workload Plan to edit" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge.
5. Click on workloadPlan name
   Data: workloadPlan: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit
   Expected: Details page of workload plan is displayed:

* 4h on Monday
* 8h on Tuedsay
* 8h on Wednesday
* 8h on Thursday
* 4h on Friday
* 0h on Saturday and Sunday
6. Navigate back to Workload plan list and click on Edit button next to workloadPlan1 and workloadPlan2 and set newName and description
   Data: workloadPlan1: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit
newName: TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level

workloadPlan2: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit 2
newName: TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level 2
   Expected: Changes are saved.

Workload plan synchronized from Tempo is overwritten in BP level. Blue pencil icon is displayed next to workload plan name.
7. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Workload
   Expected: Workload tab is displayed

"TC-538 Workload Plan to edit" is still displayed on the list. Changes made in BP level are not visible in Tempo.
8. Click on name of workloadScheme1 and workloadScheme2 and set newName
   Data: workloadScheme1: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit
newName: TC-538 Workload Plan resynchronized



workloadScheme2: TC-538 Workload Plan to edit 2
newName: TC-538 Workload Plan resynchronized 2
   Expected: Changes are saved
9. Navigate to BP Administration -> Workload plans tab
   Expected: Workload plans tab is displayed

"TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level" and "TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level 2" are still displayed on the list
10. Click on workloadName1 to open details page
   Data: workloadName1: TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level
   Expected: Workload details page is displayed. 

Additional "Resynchronize with Tempo" button is displayed in right header
11. Click on Resynchronize with Tempo button
   Expected: Workload plan is resynchronized. 

Workload name "TC-538 Workload Plan resynchronized" is displayed in left header.
12. Go back to Workload plans tab, click on Synchronize button and refresh
   Expected: "TC-538 Workload Plan resynchronized" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge

"TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level 2" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge and blue pencil next to it
13. Click on workloadName1 to open details page and edit name to newWorkloadName1 and change it again to workloadName1
   Data: workloadName1: TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level

newWorkloadName1:  TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level 2
   Expected: Name of workload plan 'TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level' is still the same. 

Resynchronize button is active

'Pencil' icon is visible
14. Click Resynchronize button
   Expected: Pencil icon disappeared 

'TC-538 Workload Plan edited on BP level' has SYNCED status
